SlideMate 0.3.1 makes first-time setup a two-step, no-Terminal-typing affair.

### New
- **One-click AI setup**: Claude and ChatGPT each have an **Install & sign in** button. It runs the installer in a
  Terminal window, then opens your browser to sign in. Nothing to copy and paste.
- **Sign-in is noticed automatically**: no more Re-check button. The setup screen updates by itself (and picks the AI
  that's ready) as soon as you finish.
- **Command Line Tools install themselves**: if your Mac doesn't have Python yet, SlideMate opens Apple's installer and
  carries on starting up by itself when it's done.
- **A shorter welcome screen**: just (1) your slides folder and (2) your AI. **Get started** unlocks once both work,
  so you can't land in an app that can't answer questions. Everything else is in Settings (⌘,).

### Fixes
- **Send to iPad no longer hangs when the iPad is off or asleep**: after 8 s SlideMate closes the empty AirDrop panel and
  says it couldn't find your iPad.

### Install
Already on 0.3.0? SlideMate offers this update by itself (or choose SlideMate → **Check for Updates…**).

New here: download **SlideMate-0.3.1-macOS.zip** below, unzip it, and drag SlideMate into Applications. First open:
macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**; macOS 13–14: right-click → **Open**. The app isn't
notarised yet.
